authority: Current explicit parent conveys user instruction
publication_checks: Necessary deployment/package/identity/availability checks only. Reuse unchanged accepted model evidence; no additional repeated full-batch model acceptance.
identity_guard: Match exact batch, four IDs, source and each GLB hash; wrong-subject reply is invalid, not a completed model review.
changes_or_real_defects: Mandatory repair sites receive targeted difference-only review against the prior independent findings, not another full-batch independent QA. Parent coordinates exact changed source/GLB evidence; no stale/mismatched PASS.
historical_contract_boundary: Frozen static profile and integrity/provenance checks retained; workflow does not add a second model-acceptance gate.
mandatory_repairs_review: Difference-only recheck of required corrections; exactly one independent full model QA round.
